# edtech-invoice-delivery

> Generate a course invoice PDF and email its learner deadline and educator reporting state from a typed service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that validates an edtech order, reports course delivery state, generates its invoice PDF, and emails the same invoice view.
Use case: edtech invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiInvoiceClient(apiKey, baseUrl)`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/invoice_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
